verdict.rationale: Moss documents its own runtime running locally: in the browser, on-device, or at the edge. Real-time sessions can index and query locally, and the GitHub repo includes a WASM build. However, indexes are hydrated from and synced to the Moss cloud, and the load path falls back to a snapshot only when the cloud is unreachable, so the managed backend appears required rather than self-hostable. Missing for 10: documented self-hosting of the full backend/control plane without the Moss cloud, deployment/ops guidance for self-hosted servers, and independent confirmation of fully offline or self-hosted operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
